product_overview: Terawet Modern Web Platform is a responsive multilingual commercial portal for Terawet hydrogel and agricultural moisture-retention technologies. It provides product discovery, application guidance, contact and lead generation, and an AI voice advisor for buyer consultations.
core_goals: Present Terawet products and brand information in a modern, responsive web experience
Enable users to browse cataloged hydrogel and industrial products with supporting specifications
Provide application guidance and dosage estimation for agricultural and forestry use cases
Support multilingual access for Ukrainian, English, and Bulgarian users
Capture wholesale and inquiry leads through a contact form
Offer real-time buyer support through an embedded conversational voice assistant

features.name: Navigation & Header
features.description: Global navigation that helps users move across the site, switch languages, and access key pages from any screen size.
user_flows: Open the site and load the top navigation with Home, Catalog, Application, About, and Contacts links -> Select a page link -> Navigate to the chosen page -> View the corresponding section content
Load the site on a mobile viewport -> Open the responsive drawer menu -> Select a navigation item -> Navigate to the selected page
Change the language selector from UK to EN or BG -> Application updates visible labels and navigation text -> Continue browsing in the selected language
Attempt to access a missing or invalid route -> Router returns a not-found state or redirect handling -> User remains within the site shell with navigation available

features.name: Home & Hero Section
features.description: Landing page experience that introduces the brand, highlights key benefits, and directs users to the catalog or video content.
user_flows: Open the home page -> Hero section renders brand tagline and CTA buttons -> Click Explore Catalog -> Navigate to the Product Catalog page
Open the home page -> Hero section renders video-related CTA -> Click Watch Video -> Open or navigate to the brand video content
Load the home page -> Product showcase carousel appears with core hydrogel categories -> Browse featured items -> Select a featured product or CTA to continue
Attempt to load home page content when assets fail to resolve -> Show fallback UI for unavailable media or showcase content -> Keep core navigation and CTAs available

features.name: Product Catalog
features.description: Categorized catalog where users can review Terawet Care, Terawet Gel, TeraFood, and Industrial Bulk offerings with product details and packaging information.
user_flows: Open the catalog page -> Retrieve and display product categories from the product data source -> Browse Terawet Care, Terawet Gel, TeraFood, and Industrial Bulk entries -> View product specifications and usage indicators
Open the catalog page -> Select an industrial bulk product card -> View packaging details such as 25kg or 1kg bags -> Review intended use and product summary
Open the catalog page -> Filter or switch between product categories -> Catalog updates to the chosen category -> Inspect the product list for that category
Request a catalog view with unavailable or malformed product data -> Show an empty state or error message -> Keep the page usable for navigation and retry

features.name: Application & Dosage Calculator
features.description: Guidance page for applying the product in forestry, horticulture, gardens, and open-field farming, including dosage estimation tools.
user_flows: Open the application page -> View step-by-step application instructions -> Enter crop, tree, or garden parameters into the dosage calculator -> Receive a recommended dosage estimate per hectare or per plant

Open the application page -> Select a different application scenario such as forestry or horticulture -> Instructions and dosage guidance update for the selected scenario -> Review the recommended usage steps
Enter valid dosage inputs -> Submit the calculator form -> Receive a calculated dosage result -> Use the result to plan application
Enter invalid or incomplete calculator inputs -> Submit the calculator form -> Receive validation feedback or an error state -> Correct the values and resubmit

features.name: About & Scientific Verification
features.description: Informational page covering company history, ecological impact, patents, and laboratory verification of the product.
user_flows: Open the About page -> View company history, ecological impact, patents, and lab test information -> Read scientific verification content
Open the About page -> Select a supporting section such as patents or laboratory tests -> Jump to the relevant details -> Review verification evidence
Attempt to load About page content with missing media or unavailable data -> Show partial content or fallback states -> Preserve access to the remaining informational sections

features.name: Contact & Inquiry Form
features.description: Contact page that displays company contact details and provides a form for wholesale quote requests and lead generation.
user_flows: Open the Contacts page -> View phone number, email, and headquarters address -> Submit a wholesale inquiry form with valid details -> Receive confirmation that the inquiry was submitted
Open the Contacts page -> Enter required contact and order information -> Submit the form with missing or invalid fields -> Receive validation errors -> Correct the inputs and resubmit
Open the Contacts page -> Review contact information without submitting the form -> Use the displayed address or email to continue the sales conversation
Submit the inquiry form when the service is unavailable -> Receive a submission failure message -> Retry the request or contact the company using the listed details

features.name: Multilingual Support (i18n)
features.description: Language switching that allows users to view the site in Ukrainian, English, or Bulgarian.
user_flows: Load the app in Ukrainian -> Change language to English using the language switcher -> UI text updates across shared layout and pages -> Continue browsing in English
Load the app -> Change language to Bulgarian -> Page labels and navigation text update -> Open another page to confirm the selected language persists
Select a supported language that is not currently active -> Translation resources load -> Content re-renders in the chosen language
Attempt to switch to an unsupported locale -> Keep the current language or fall back to a default supported language -> Continue displaying the site without breaking navigation

features.name: Conversational AI Voice Widget
features.description: Floating voice assistant that lets buyers speak with a Terawet virtual advisor for real-time consultation.
user_flows: Open the site -> Voice widget appears as a floating assistant -> Start a conversation with the Terawet advisor -> Receive spoken or conversational guidance on products and buying questions
Open the site -> Expand the voice widget -> Ask a question about bulk ordering or product selection -> Receive relevant consultation guidance -> Continue the conversation
Open the widget when voice permissions are denied or unavailable -> Show permission or connection error feedback -> Retry after enabling access or continue using standard site navigation
Send a question that cannot be resolved by the assistant -> Receive a fallback response or escalation guidance -> Use the contact page for direct inquiry
